data.long_meaning: Fawaz is an Arabic name that symbolizes inner peace and tranquility. It represents a state of being free from worries and troubles. People with the name Fawaz are known for their calm demeanor and soothing presence. The name Fawaz carries the meaning “Tranquil, peaceful, calm” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Fawaz usually hope their child will grow to embody tranquil, peaceful, calm and live with faith, good character and purpose.
